fields.statement: Verifier claude-code-76a416b6 at 637aff02a (attempt 5): go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(repair|describe-golden|render-refuses-damaged-log)$' passes. repair.txtar reproduces the incident (uncommitted, index-seen entry overwritten with another entry's bytes): repair --dry-run names it (from index) and leaves bytes and mode 644 unchanged; repair restores the original bytes at 0444; render and fold-ok pass. A junk entry the index never saw is reported not restorable with exit non-zero. go test -trimpath ./internal/index/... passes. go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... prints PASS; the only FAIL is the known root-state guard on ~/code/.rhiza-root/usage.live.json, not this diff.
